codeReview.summary: Implementation correctly adds ContextMenu (right-click) and DropdownMenu (hover '...' button) to ThumbnailCard with Rename and Delete actions. Follows all established patterns from VideoCard and PromptCard reference files. Uses useMutation with resolveActionResult for both operations, dialogManager.input() for rename with defaultValue, dialogManager.confirm() with destructive variant for delete, and invalidates promptKeys.all on success. Event propagation is properly stopped on the dropdown trigger to preserve Link navigation. All expected behaviors from the feature description are covered.

issues.description: Unrelated change committed: next-env.d.ts path changed from './.next/dev/types/routes.d.ts' to './.next/types/routes.d.ts'. This is an auto-generated file modified by Next.js during the tsc --noEmit run. It's harmless but technically out of scope for this feature.

The handleRename guard `if (value)` will reject empty strings but also silently does nothing when input dialog returns undefined/empty. The UpdatePromptNameSchema allows empty strings (z.string().max(100) with no min). This is actually good UX behavior — prevents saving empty names — but could be made more explicit with a min(1) validation or showing an error message.

summary: Feature passes review. ThumbnailCard now has a hover-reveal MoreVertical dropdown and right-click context menu with Rename and Delete actions. Implementation closely follows VideoCard and PromptCard patterns. Both mutations use useMutation with proper cache invalidation and toast notifications. Card navigation via Link is preserved with event propagation handling. Two non-blocking issues noted: an unrelated next-env.d.ts auto-change was committed, and the rename empty-string guard could be more explicit. No shared state gaps beyond a potential library entry for the known flaky test.
